newsitem.title: JAPAN: Economic forces to spur Japan recovery working-BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Economic forces to spur Japan recovery working-BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita on Tuesday reiterated that forces to prompt economic recovery in Japan were gradually, but steadily working.
Matsushita, on the second day of a two-day tour of western Japan, was addressing a gathering of business executives.
"Cyclical forces to spur recovery are gradually but steadily working," Matsushita said.
In Osaka on Monday, Matsushita said the strength of the economic recovery appears to be becoming more solid.
Matsushita also repeated remarks made on Monday that Japanese companies remain cautious about their business oulook, but overall business activities are firm at the moment.
Matsushita said the main reason why the economy is still only recovering gradually is that Japanese companies are under continued pressure from restructuring.

"However, companies are now more flexible as a result of their long-term term efforts to restructure their business. The pressure from structural adjustment may persist for some time longer, but such pressure may gradually decrease as companies make efforts to get over it," he said.
He reiterated that the BOJ's monetary policy will continue to be aimed at ensuring a basis for economic recovery.
